note: Five handwritten Singlish opening messages for the blind human evaluation, written before any system answered them. Not shown in the report or slides before the ratings are in.

queries.text: Eh I just found out my whole project group went for supper without me, and they were discussing our project there. Feel like they don't want me in the group.
Prelims coming already and I haven't even finished revising one subject. My parents expect me to get into NUS, I scared I disappoint them.
My best friend got together with the guy I liked and never tell me. Now every time I see them together I feel so lousy.
Work part-time and study full-time, I damn tired already. Weekends also no rest, I don't know how long I can tahan.
My CCA leader always scold me in front of everyone, I feel so paiseh. Thinking of quitting but scared people say I give up.
